board_card_events_evidence_check.name: board_card_events_evidence_check
board_card_events_evidence_check.value: "corp"."board_card_events"."kind" <> 'terminada' OR "corp"."board_card_events"."link" IS NOT NULL OR "corp"."board_card_events"."document_id" IS NOT NULL

board_card_events_ruling_check.name: board_card_events_ruling_check
board_card_events_ruling_check.value: ("corp"."board_card_events"."kind" = 'resuelta') = ("corp"."board_card_events"."accepted" IS NOT NULL) AND ("corp"."board_card_events"."kind" <> 'resuelta' OR "corp"."board_card_events"."document_id" IS NOT NULL)

board_cards_task_check.name: board_cards_task_check
board_cards_task_check.value: "corp"."board_cards"."kind" = 'entregable' OR ("corp"."board_cards"."value_f1" IS NULL AND "corp"."board_cards"."value_f2" IS NULL AND "corp"."board_cards"."quote" IS NULL)

entries_usd_check.name: entries_usd_check
entries_usd_check.value:
("corp"."entries"."moneda" = 'MXN' AND "corp"."entries"."monto_original" IS NULL AND "corp"."entries"."tipo_cambio" IS NULL)
          OR ("corp"."entries"."moneda" = 'USD' AND "corp"."entries"."monto_original" > 0 AND "corp"."entries"."tipo_cambio" IS NOT NULL)

received_invoices_usd_check.name: received_invoices_usd_check
received_invoices_usd_check.value:
("corp"."received_invoices"."moneda" = 'MXN' AND "corp"."received_invoices"."monto_original" IS NULL AND "corp"."received_invoices"."tipo_cambio" IS NULL)
          OR ("corp"."received_invoices"."moneda" = 'USD' AND "corp"."received_invoices"."monto_original" > 0 AND "corp"."received_invoices"."tipo_cambio" IS NOT NULL)

received_invoices_registrada_check.name: received_invoices_registrada_check
received_invoices_registrada_check.value: "corp"."received_invoices"."estado" <> 'registrada' OR ("corp"."received_invoices"."entry_id" IS NOT NULL AND "corp"."received_invoices"."categoria" IS NOT NULL)

received_invoices_pago_check.name: received_invoices_pago_check
received_invoices_pago_check.value: "corp"."received_invoices"."pago_entry_id" IS NULL OR ("corp"."received_invoices"."metodo_pago" = 'PPD' AND "corp"."received_invoices"."entry_id" IS NOT NULL)

services_montos_check.name: services_montos_check
services_montos_check.value:
("corp"."services"."monto" IS NULL OR "corp"."services"."monto" > 0) AND ("corp"."services"."aviso" IS NULL OR "corp"."services"."aviso" > 0)
          AND ("corp"."services"."gasto_mes" IS NULL OR "corp"."services"."gasto_mes" >= 0)

services_plan_check.name: services_plan_check
services_plan_check.value: ("corp"."services"."limite" IS NULL OR "corp"."services"."limite" > 0) AND ("corp"."services"."uso_plan" IS NULL OR "corp"."services"."uso_plan" >= 0)

share_events_partners_check.name: share_events_partners_check
share_events_partners_check.value:
"corp"."share_events"."to_socio" IN (1, 2) AND (
        ("corp"."share_events"."kind" = 'suscripcion' AND "corp"."share_events"."from_socio" IS NULL)
        OR ("corp"."share_events"."kind" = 'transmision' AND "corp"."share_events"."from_socio" IN (1, 2) AND "corp"."share_events"."from_socio" <> "corp"."share_events"."to_socio"))
